objective: Build the enlarged 'How It Works' section: a persistent SVG pipeline map of the 5 default agents plus a single-active-media agent deep-dive (one focused demo clip per agent/opt-in mode), accessible (global pause, reduced-motion static fallback) and performant (MP4+WebM lazy, bounded concurrency). Generate the per-agent clips with a reusable Pillow/ffmpeg renderer matching the existing demo.gif style.

criteria.label: No leftover TODO/FIXME in new section

tasks.desc: Add gifsicle devDependency + verify Pillow/ffmpeg renderer toolchain
Write tools/render_agent_demo.py: reusable TUI frame renderer (Pillow + JetBrains Mono) -> mp4/webm/gif/poster
Define 8 clip scripts and generate all assets into public/agent-demos/
HowItWorks.jsx Part A: SVG pipeline map of 5 default agents + animated handoff edges
HowItWorks.jsx Part B: sticky-media process deep-dive, one active clip at a time
HowItWorks.jsx Part C: opt-in/advanced modes tabbed area
Cross-cutting: global pause/stop, reduced-motion fallback, lazy video + IO + controls
Wire into App.jsx, add CSS, reconcile 4->5 agent copy

negative_knowledge: gifsicle reads GIF only, not PNG: build GIF via Pillow with a shared adaptive palette + optimize (small ~100KB), then gifsicle -O3; ffmpeg-palette GIF was 6.9MB/frame-heavy.
AgentClip refs must be index-assigned, not push(), or the refs array grows unbounded across re-renders.
Niki's Tester only simulates tests (verified in source) — clip copy frames it as 'reasoned/simulated', never 'executed'.
context_summary: Implemented the enlarged How It Works section per research/plans. Added gifsicle devDep; wrote tools/render_agent_demo.py (Pillow + JetBrains Mono) producing 8 agent clips (planner, coder, tester, red, reviewer, synthesizer, security, solo) each as mp4+webm+gif+poster into public/agent-demos/ (~100KB gif / ~100KB mp4 each, 2.5MB total). Built src/components/HowItWorks.jsx: Part A SVG pipeline map of the 5 default agents (Planner->Coder->Tester->Red->Reviewer) with animated handoff edges; Part B sticky-media process deep-dive that plays only the active agent's clip at a time (scroll-spy); Part C tabbed opt-in modes. Cross-cutting: global Pause/Play control (WCAG 2.2.2), prefers-reduced-motion static fallback with opt-in 'Show animations', lazy <video> with poster + preload none. Wired into App.jsx (replacing Pipeline), added CSS, reconciled 4->5 agent copy in Pipeline.jsx and Demo.jsx. Build passes; all 5 criteria PASS; 32 clip assets generated and emitted to dist/agent-demos.
